entries.story_action: Cold morning: the recurring woman and silver coin introduce the world; woodland opens toward village/workday.
entries.animation_behavior: restrained forest/hair/flower motion; mist and dappled light; slow bounded depth reveal
entries.lyric_cue: The morning steals the warmth away / miller counts his gold

entries.story_action: Workday weight: sacks, wagon, road and workers pass around her without turning the film into literal illustration.
entries.animation_behavior: selective worker/wagon motion, cloth, wheel, dust; cool-to-warm sunlight shift
entries.lyric_cue: We carry sacks and wood and grain / final wagon rests

entries.story_action: Threshold: cold road gives way to the inn; warmth begins leaking into the frame.
entries.animation_behavior: rain/reflections outside, window/fire breathing inside, door-layer parallax
entries.lyric_cue: fire fills the room / laugh away the gloom

entries.story_action: First chorus opens the tavern into communal life: mugs, hands, laughter and rhythm.
entries.animation_behavior: firelight/smoke, clap response, sleeves/hair, crowd micro-motion, mug accents
entries.lyric_cue: Raise your mugs and stamp the beat / what the master takes by day

entries.story_action: Fiddle and floorboards take over; the room becomes a living painting rather than a montage.
entries.animation_behavior: bow/hand-safe fiddler motion, crowd sway, dance fabric, localized camera energy
entries.lyric_cue: Play, my fiddler, fast and loud / poor in coin, but rich in song

entries.story_action: Verse 2 becomes a playful merchant encounter centered on the woman, not a new protagonist.
entries.visual_media: new support coverage derived from locked woman/coin/tavern canon
entries.animation_behavior: subtle expression/gesture, cup/coin/hat movement, stable face/hands, restrained room motion
entries.lyric_cue: A merchant spoke of finest silk / little cup ran dry

entries.story_action: The joke resolves: silver coin changes hands and the cold outside briefly echoes behind the warm room.
entries.animation_behavior: coin handoff detail, shadow wipe, exterior cold reflection, warm fire continuity
entries.lyric_cue: I took his hat and silver coin / left the man alone

entries.story_action: Second chorus returns with a denser room and stronger group rhythm.
entries.animation_behavior: stronger clap/mug response, fire/smoke, layered crowd parallax, transient light accents
entries.lyric_cue: Raise your mugs and stamp the beat / take back before dawn

entries.story_action: Fiddler and dancers answer the chorus; motion approaches reference-A intensity without topology drift.
entries.animation_behavior: bow waveform/light, dance sway, skirt/sleeve motion, bounded push
entries.lyric_cue: Play, my fiddler, fast and loud / living hearts still wake

entries.story_action: Bridge widens to the whole working community—farmer, smith, carter—seen as one social world.
entries.animation_behavior: localized character micro-actions, ember/forge hints, cloth, shadow, table activity
entries.lyric_cue: The farmer curses / smith turns red / carter sings too loud

entries.story_action: Private human moments inside the crowd: barmaid mischief, hidden bread, affection, then the reminder of tomorrow.
entries.visual_media: new support coverage inside locked tavern world
entries.animation_behavior: small gestures, eye-lines, hands protected, candle heat haze, background crowd breathing
entries.lyric_cue: maid has hidden the landlord's bread / farmhand kisses his love / tomorrow work will call

entries.story_action: A brief breath at the threshold: tomorrow waits outside, but tonight still belongs to the room.
entries.animation_behavior: twilight-to-night pigment shift, fog/rain, window glow, restrained lightning/reflection
entries.lyric_cue: wine and songs belong tonight / those with little coin

entries.story_action: Final chorus: the accepted hero set finally interlocks—toast, clap, fiddle and dance—at peak communal energy.
entries.animation_behavior: fast but readable source-canon intercut, reactive accents, crowd/fire motion, no face drift
entries.lyric_cue: Raise your mugs and stamp the beat / everything that makes life bitter / fiddler fast and loud

entries.story_action: Resolution: the coin returns to the woman, but the room and human connection remain the real wealth.
entries.animation_behavior: activity gently falls, coin glint resolves, warm afterglow, breath/hair/flower motion, minimal camera
entries.lyric_cue: Poor in coin, but rich in song / while living hearts still wake
entries.transition: hold warm portrait/room afterglow into audio end
